terra.problem: Ruth being from Moab is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The text does not say Ruth heard Boaz’s name in the field.
The claim that people gather at the city gate in the Bible needs a Scripture reference.
Naomi tells Ruth to go to the threshing floor and not let Boaz know she is there yet. She does not tell Ruth not to enter as soon as she arrives.
Naomi does not say morning would be too late. Boaz’s discovery of Ruth at midnight establishes what happened, not a deadline Naomi gave.
Ruth being from Moab and gleaning in Boaz’s fields are facts from outside this passage and need references.
The passage does not say Ruth returned to Naomi on her own.
Ruth being from Moab is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
“No gold stars for the money answer” is negative about the baker’s answer.
The size of the measures is not given, so the passage does not establish that six measures is a lot.
The explanation calls the baker’s answer “wrong,” which the hard rules prohibit.
“Naomi knows Boaz is on it” presents his current activity as fact. The passage gives Naomi’s expectation, not an account of what Boaz is doing at that moment.
The passage does not say Boaz is moving fast or rule out his thinking the matter over. Naomi says he will not rest unless he has resolved it that day.
